text:
emma_sales: Peter (customer) wants an air-gapped POC in their colo. Key asks: weekly minibundles, customer HSM signing, no vendor key custody, delta delivery via rsync-like chunks, and a USB-sneakernet emergency hotfix option. Any immediate blockers?

jon_se: We can do unsigned minibundles + a signing-helper that runs inside the customer's network (pkcs11). Two notable asks: they prefer blake2b checksums to save compute; we currently default to sha256 but can add blake2b verifier. Also need to agree recovery path for migrations.

tara_infra: Packaging constraints: if they pin drivers or ship custom kernels, diffs grow significantly. We'll enforce a policy: weekly minibundles must be non-migration (no DB/schema changes). Monthly fulls carry migrations. For chunking we recommend zstd-compressed chunks with manifest and blake2b checksums. Bandwidth estimate 35-55GB/week depending on pinned binaries.

lucy_sec: Security redlines: Redwood must never receive private keys. They want an HSM signing certificate (public) and an audit attestation after each sign operation. For the USB hotfix, signing must happen in-customer and include a time-stamped attestation file. Legal will need SOW language.

peter_cust: Confirmed: we will run signing in our HSM (nShield). For emergencies we want a sealed USB process: Redwood will prepare an artifact unsigned; we sign locally and ship USB to our operations team. Also ask for SLA: minibundle acceptance test <=30 minutes after install or auto-revert.

jon_se: Proposed commands (run inside customer network):
```
# sign inside customer's jumpbox with pkcs11
./sign-helper sign --bundle /mnt/artifacts/minibundle.tar.gz \
  --pkcs11-module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --slot 1 --key-label "acme-poc" \
  --out /mnt/artifacts/minibundle.sig --checksum blake2b

# verify
./verify --manifest /mnt/artifacts/manifest.json --sig /mnt/artifacts/minibundle.sig
```

tara_infra: Rollback plan: staged canary (5/25/100) with health probes + automatic revert on failed probe. For true DB migrations we schedule in monthly full with manual migration plan and explicit rollback SQL. We'll include a preflight checklist.

lucy_sec: SOW draft note: "Redwood will only provide signing tooling; customer retains exclusive custody of private key material and signing operations. Redwood will not accept or persist private keys or signed private key material." Also require customer to provide a signing certificate (pub) and attestations post-sign.

pkg-bot: PKG-4242 created: add blake2b support to verifier, produce sign-helper container with pkcs11 examples, draft preflight and USB hotfix runbook.

emma_sales: Pricing ask: Peter expects an engineering packaging fee + per-minibundle handling. Quick sketch: one-time packaging/validation $12k, per-minibundle $450. I'll refine after infra tests. Meeting Tue 11am PT to confirm. :thumbsup:
